name: modify_message
description:
Modify properties of an Outlook message: mark as read/unread, set importance, or toggle flag status.

Common operations:
- Mark as read: is_read = true
- Mark as unread: is_read = false
- Flag for follow-up: flag_status = "flagged"
- Complete flag: flag_status = "complete"
- Clear flag: flag_status = "notFlagged"
- Set high importance: importance = "high"

The message_id should come from outlook_search or outlook_get_message.

message_id.description: Message ID to modify (from outlook_search or outlook_get_message)

is_read.description: Set to true to mark as read, false to mark as unread
